assetCoverage.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, our asset coverage ratio was approximately 183.7% and our asset coverage ratio per unit was approximately $1,837.

nonAccrualFvPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, loans to four portfolio companies and equipment financings to one portfolio company were on non-accrual status, with a total cost of approximately $41.0 million, and a total fair value of approximately $18.7 million, or 0.8%, of the fair value of the Company's debt investment portfolio.
